data.one_liner: Dart bindings for the ElasticSearch HTTP API.
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart bindings to interact with the ElasticSearch HTTP API for full-text search and document operations. Allows developers to run queries, count documents, and work with aggregations from Dart applications.
use_when: You need to communicate with an ElasticSearch backend from a Dart or Flutter application.
You want to perform full-text searches, count items, or run aggregations against ElasticSearch.
avoid_when: You are looking for an integrated local database or key-value storage solution on the device.
You need a robust, cluster-aware transport layer with advanced automatic failover and node selection.
strengths: Enables direct integration with ElasticSearch from Dart.
Supports various query types like match phrase, regexp, and knn.
weaknesses: API is expected to change and subject to breaking changes.
Lacks cluster-aware transport features such as latency-aware or routing-aware node selection.
data.setup_notes: Add the package as a dependency and configure connectivity to your ElasticSearch instance.
